items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: We had Ernie Wilkins and his brother playing in the band at this time.

ctx.x: Then we started working in '47. We would work in the Tunetown Ballroom maybe two or three times a week. And the last date we had at the Tunetown Ballroom was the last night the Tunetown Ballroom was open. The Internal Revenue men came in, and closed the Tunetown Ballroom down. They owed us about $800- some. Which was a lot of money back at that time. We never got
a penny of our money. We had Ernie Wilkins and his brother playing in the band at this time. Ernie was writing real nice, was writing real good.
